notes.title: Lily’s Labyrinth of Lust – Dev Update & Progress on 0.9
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re getting closer to the release of Lily’s Labyrinth of Lust 0.9, and we're focused on polishing things up to ensure a smoother experience. While there’s no update this week, we’re making key improvements behind the scenes.

Things to tackle at the moment like:

 Adjustments to Lily’s AI to prevent her from getting stuck on things 
 Fixes for collision issues that sometimes caused players to fall through the map
 General stability and bug fixes that shouldn't be in the game and causes annoyance

What’s Next?
We’ll be sharing more details on version 0.9 soon, including a deeper look at what’s changing. Keep an eye out for upcoming announcements in the near future!

As always, we appreciate your support—let us know your thoughts in the discussions!

notes.title: Patch 0.8.5.1 Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,  

Patch 0.8.5.1 for Lily's Labyrinth of Lust has just been released! 

This update brings some exciting new features, bug fixes, and performance improvements to enhance your experience.  

[hr][/hr]  
Patch Highlights  
  
 Dynamic Difficulty: A new system to make gameplay more engaging and adapt to your playstyle.  
 Low Graphics Mode: Optimized settings to ensure smoother performance on lower-end hardware.  
 Front-End Optimizations: Smoother gameplay across the board for all players.  
 Camera Fixes: Resolved bugs causing issues with camera movement and positioning.  
 Alternate Skin Bug Fixes: Addressed color glitches related to the Nude Outfit.  
  
Back-End Improvements  
  
 Material Pooling and Collision Optimization: Enhanced material performance for better visuals and stability.  
 Liquid Cum Improvements: Enhanced collision, X-ray effects, and inside materials for a more immersive experience.  
 Minor Material Fixes: Adjusted various material assignments for consistency.  
 Improved MC Skin Tones: Polished the main character's skin tones for better visuals.  
  

[hr][/hr]  
How Can You Help?  
We’d love for you to test the new build and share your thoughts! 

Feedback and suggestions from our players are vital for improving the game and delivering the best experience possible.  

Join the conversation and share your thoughts directly with the community and devs on our Discord server.  

[hr][/hr]  
Closing Thoughts  
Our team has been hard at work to bring both exciting new features and better optimization to Lily's Labyrinth of Lust. These updates aim to ensure the game runs smoothly, even for players on lower-end hardware, so more people can enjoy the experience.  

We truly value your input, so please continue to share your feedback and suggestions. Together, we’ll keep improving and expanding Lily's Labyrinth of Lust!  

Thank you for your continued support and for being part of our journey.  

- Erommersion Team
